title: Composition of locally quasi-finite scheme morphisms
statement: Let $X,Y,S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $f:X\to Y$ and $h:Y\to S$ be morphisms. If both $f$ and $h$ are locally quasi-finite in the scheme sense [pqf-def-quasifinite], then $h\circ f:X\to S$ is locally quasi-finite in that same sense. Here local quasi-finiteness includes the finite-type affine neighbourhood condition of [pqf-def-quasifinite]. No quasi-compactness, separatedness or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 01TL (lemma-composition-quasi-finite), locally quasi-finite assertion; affine proof via Tag 01TK and Algebra Tag 00PO.

proof.text: Fix a point x of X, and write y=f(x), s=h(y). By [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis], choose an affine open W of S containing s, then an affine open V of Y containing y inside the open h^{-1}(W), then an affine open U of X containing x inside f^{-1}(V). Thus f(U) is contained in V and h(V) is contained in W. Only inverse images of opens and the affine basis are used; no intersection of affine opens is asserted to be affine.

source.place: Tag 01TL (lemma-composition-quasi-finite), locally quasi-finite assertion, expanding the affine-neighbourhood argument via Tag 01TK.

proof.text: Apply implication (1) => (2) of [lem-a1-scheme-lqf-affine-criterion] to h with the affine pair V,W and to f with the affine pair U,V. It gives ring maps O_S(W) -> O_Y(V) and O_Y(V) -> O_X(U), each of finite type and quasi-finite at every prime of its target. These conclusions follow from the given scheme-sense local quasi-finiteness, so the finite-type condition has not been dropped.

source.place: Tag 01TL (lemma-composition-quasi-finite), locally quasi-finite assertion, expanding the affine-neighbourhood argument via Tag 01TK.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-quasi-finite-composition] with A=O_S(W), B=O_Y(V), C=O_X(U). Both of its finite-type and every-prime hypotheses were obtained in step 2. Hence the composite A -> C is of finite type and quasi-finite at every prime of C. By the definition of composition of scheme morphisms, the map on these sections for h o f is exactly this composite: for a in O_S(W), (h o f)^#(a)=f^#(h^#(a)).

source.place: Tag 01TL (lemma-composition-quasi-finite), locally quasi-finite assertion, expanding the affine-neighbourhood argument via Tag 01TK.

proof.text: In particular the composite ring map is quasi-finite at the prime of O_X(U) corresponding to x. The affine neighbourhoods U,W satisfy (h o f)(U) contained in W and the required finite-type condition. They therefore witness quasi-finiteness of h o f at x by [pqf-def-quasifinite]. As x was arbitrary, the composite is locally quasi-finite. If X is empty the same universal assertion is vacuous.

source.place: Tag 01TL (lemma-composition-quasi-finite), locally quasi-finite assertion, expanding the affine-neighbourhood argument via Tag 01TK.
